review_scope: Exhaustive section/paragraph completeness checks; targeted bilingual editorial comparison of arguments, evidence boundaries, conclusions and natural phrasing. Not an independent line-by-line historical certification of all twenty texts.
notes: Chinese and English pages, including the shared Traditional Chinese reading path, remain byte-for-byte unchanged in this batch.
Preserve the supplied distinctions between reports, conjectures and established facts in the 1934 refereeing/Sindelar passages, Brazil's racialized scapegoating and the 1954 doping controversy.
EP01 five-language manuscripts describe two months as travel plus tournament absence; Chinese says sea travel. This supplied clarification is retained and disclosed, not silently applied to Chinese.
Short standalone titles and translated decks avoid duplicating episode numbers already in the page shell. Bodies retain every source paragraph.
EP12 and EP16 source corrections agreed with the author are reserved for their respective later batches.

ep01.de.before: und teilte den Streit schließlich hälftig auf.

ep01.fr.before: Deux mois d’absence, c’est perdre une petite moitié de la saison.

ep01.ja.before: アマチュアという理想は、本質的には、一度の植民化だった。
ep01.ja.after: アマチュアという理想は、本質的には一種の植民化だった。
ep01.ja.reason: Natural Japanese: characterize the ideal, not the number of times colonization happened.

ep01.ja.before: 初日から、その姿を固定したがった構と、初日から、固定できなかったその運命。
ep01.ja.after: 初日からその姿を固定したがった構と、初日から固定できなかったその運命。
ep01.ja.reason: Ease overpunctuated parallel clauses without changing the refrain.

ep02.ja.before: 彼の死は、この歴史のなかで、最も筆を抑えなければならない部分である。

ep02.ja.reason: Make evidential caution explicit in natural prose without changing any evidence claim.

ep03.ja.before: 人種の符号化というものは、むしろ一そろいの言葉や、疑われることのない先入観の中で働く。

ep03.ja.reason: Express racial coding in accessible Japanese rather than an information-encoding calque.

ep04.es.reason: Remove the unclear pronoun and express the unresolved case idiomatically.
